subject: SOC2 Type II: Supplemental authn/authz evidence request
messages:
From: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@medbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@medbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts (MFA, access reviews, token revocations)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you provided. As part of our procurement audit for MedBridge, the security team needs a few supplemental artifacts and clarifications beyond the report for the audit period ending 2026-06-30. Please can you provide the following: 

1) MFA authentication events (successful/failed) slice covering 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 UTC. CSV extract with columns: timestamp, user_email, event_type (success|fail), auth_method, source_ip.
2) Evidence of periodic access reviews for privileged roles (audit exports or reviewer attestations) covering reviews performed in H1 2026.
3) Token revocation logs (service tokens and user OAuth revocations) for the same period.
4) Inventory of service accounts and their role bindings as of 2026-06-30.
5) A bridge letter confirming there were no control exceptions during the remainder of the period since the report (or an explanation if there were), and confirmation of the report's audit period (was it 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30?).
6) Confirmation of KMS key usage (KMS key IDs, cloud vendor) for data-at-rest encryption and whether customer data is separated by tenant via CMKs.

Please indicate whether you need us to accept redacted extracts or if full logs are required. Also provide a technical contact (SRE or security engineer) for follow-up on format questions.

Requested delivery: preferred by EOD 2026-08-06. If this timeline is not possible, let us know an ETA.

Thanks,
--
James Sullivan
Security Analyst, MedBridge

(Attachments requested: preferred CSV templates)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@medbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts (MFA, access reviews, token revocations)

Hi James — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested. A few clarifying points before we pull data: 

- Do you need raw log lines (full IPs/usernames) or redacted extracts (hashed emails, truncated IPs)? We typically deliver redacted CSV exports for external audits unless a signed NDA is in place.
- For the access-review evidence, would a PDF export of the reviewer attestations plus an exported CSV of role assignments suffice?
- Confirming audit period: our SOC 2 Type II report covers 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30 (yes).

Proposed plan and owners: 
- Ben Carter will pull the MFA event slice and token revocations.
- Priyom will draft a bridge letter and collate attestation artifacts for access reviews.
- I will compile service account inventory and KMS metadata.

Delivery ETA: initial package by EOD 2026-08-04, final secured drive share by 2026-08-06. We will redact PII by default; if you need raw data, please send a copy of your intake agreement or a list of required fields.

Shared draft folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example (will populate once ready).

Would you like a short walkthrough call to go over formats? I can coordinate a 30-min slot with Ben or Priyom.

Best,
--
Rachel Kim
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:04:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts — task list

Folks — forwarding James' ask. Quick task list below; please confirm ownership and ETA in-thread so I can reply to MedBridge.

Tasks:
- Ben: pull MFA event slice (2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 UTC) and token_revocations for same period. Deliver CSVs with columns James requested. Redact user emails to <user>@redacted unless they have an NDA.
- Priyom: prepare bridge letter draft and collect signed attestations/exported PDFs for access reviews performed in Q2 2026.
- Rachel (me): export service account inventory and KMS metadata (key IDs, cloud provider, whether CMK per-tenant in place). 

Constraints/notes:
- We should not disclose raw secrets or private keys. KMS output should be key IDs and vendor (e.g., GCP KMS key ring: projects/...) not key materials.
- For any requests beyond EDR/Identity logs (e.g., session recordings), escalate to legal.

Ben — can you confirm you have access to the identity logs and expected ETA?

Thanks — R
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts — task list

Ack — I’ll pull the MFA events and token revocation slices. ETA: EOD 2026-08-04.

Notes:
- MFA logs are in our identity provider (IdP) SIEM export. I’ll include event_type (success/fail), user_email (redacted), auth_method, timestamp, and source_ip (truncated to /24 unless MedBridge signs an NDA).
- Token revocations: we capture OAuth revocations and service token invalidation events; I’ll export both and label the rows.

I’ll upload CSVs to the shared drive and reply here when done.

-Ben
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: supplemental SOC 2 artifacts — task list

I’ll draft the bridge letter and pull the access-review PDFs. Question for Legal/Security: do we need to state vendor subservice orgs in the bridge (e.g., cloud provider SOC 2 scope)? MedBridge asked specifically about separation by tenant and CMK usage.

I’ll put a draft in the shared drive by 2026-08-04 EOD.

-Priyom
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@medbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T17:38:00Z
Subject: Deliverables: MFA slice, access review exports, service account inventory, bridge letter (draft)

Hi James — attaching the initial package for your review. 

Attachments (in drive and attached here as stubs):
- mfa_events_20260101_20260630.csv (CSV slice; emails redacted to <user>@redacted, source_ip truncated to /24)
- token_revocations_20260101_20260630.csv (CSV slice)
- access_review_202606.pdf (exported reviewer attestations for privileged roles)
- service_accounts_inventory_202606.csv (inventory as of 2026-06-30)
- bridge_letter_draft.pdf (draft bridge letter; Priyom drafted — see comments in the doc)

Summary notes:
- Audit period confirmed: 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30.
- Retention policy: authentication logs retained 24 months; token revocations retained 36 months; access-review artifacts retained per our retention schedule (files retained for minimum 12 months post-review).
- KMS: Customer data is encrypted at rest using Google Cloud KMS. Key identifiers are provided in the KMS metadata file in the drive (we do not export key material). We do not use per-tenant CMKs for hosted customers today; separation is logical with tenant-scoped key access controls.

If you need non-redacted logs, please share a signed data access agreement or an auditor intake form and we can evaluate. We are happy to schedule a 30-min walkthrough; available tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT.

Best regards,
--
Rachel Kim
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: mfa_events_20260101_20260630.csv (CSV), token_revocations_20260101_20260630.csv (CSV), access_review_202606.pdf (PDF), service_accounts_inventory_202606.csv (CSV), bridge_letter_draft.pdf (PDF)]
From: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@medbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@medbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-04T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Deliverables: MFA slice, access review exports, service account inventory, bridge letter (draft)

Rachel — received, thanks. We’ll review the artifacts. Two quick follow-ups: 

1) Can you include a token_revocations manifest that maps revoked token IDs to service_account_ids where applicable?
2) In the bridge letter, can you explicitly state whether any control exceptions (even low-risk) were identified between 2026-04-01 and 2026-06-30? If none, a short affirmative sentence is fine.

If needed we can sign an NDA to get non-redacted IPs for incident triage, but for procurement review the redacted CSVs are fine.

Thanks — James
